Always read and strictly obey these files at the start of every session, before answering or editing anything:

1. `AGENTS.md` (the workspace constitution)
2. `.github/skills/cutout-animator/SKILL.md` (SVG layer hierarchy, lip-sync rules, Show-Don't-Tell standards, Remotion animation rules)

If a user request conflicts with either file, follow the files and explain the conflict. The slash commands live in `.github/prompts/` (`/setup`, `/create`, `/character`, `/environment`, `/video`, `/review`). Everything written to this repository must be in English.
